package handler

import (
	"fmt"

	monster "example.com/planet/game/entities/monster"
	scene "example.com/planet/game/entities/scene"
)

// 端到端用例（scripts/test-heartbeat-generated.sh）读状态用的 handler：只读，不改 DAO。

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=memory
func handlerMonsterExampleProgress(target monster.IBehaviorEntity) (string, error) {
	component := target.BehaviorComp()
	started := 0
	if strategy, ok := component.AI().Strategy().(*monster.ExampleStrategy); ok {
		started = strategy.Started()
	}
	action, ok := component.Behavior().CurAction(monster.GroupMain).(*monster.ExampleAction)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Sprintf("idle started=%d", started), nil
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("running ticks=%d waited=%d started=%d", action.Ticks(), action.Waited().Milliseconds(), started), nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=memory
func handlerSceneSetRate(target scene.ITimeDomainEntity, rate float64) error {
	return target.TimeDomainComp().Domain().SetRate(rate)
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=memory
func handlerSceneStartExampleBeat(target scene.IHeartbeatEntity) error {
	return target.HeartbeatComp().Beat("example").Start()
}
